target_error: The final V5 output unconditionally equates maximum motion with first physical contact.
change: Keep original V5 four calls and other three outputs. One additional local contact verification call replaces only collision_frame.
candidate_windows: Internal VLM contact and final motion centers, each +/-10 valid input indices, clipped; nine uniform samples per window, retain each center by replacing its nearest sampled index if absent (earlier index removed on ties); sorted union at most18. No GT-based crop or source-frame FPS arithmetic.
parser: Accept only JSON integer collision_frame present in offered original numbers. Null, boolean, string, float, invalid or missing return original V5 motion prediction.
development_execution: Reuse the frozen actual V5 four-call outputs on identical bound PNG inputs, then run the exact candidate refine_collision function once. No reranking across multiple candidates.
reserved_execution: Only after development gate passes: same frozen code, actual V5 four calls plus candidate one call per file, once on all three reserved sources. No retuning after reserved results.
ground_truth: User's blinded single-review contact frames and native PTS. These are local human references, not official Nexar or DACON labels, and not multi-reviewer adjudication. Do not promote source JSON certification flags.
development_failure: Reject this frozen candidate; do not consume reserved predictions or package it as improved.
reserved_failure: Reject candidate for improvement submission. Preserve all results; do not adjust on reserved set and call it independent.
submission_additional_requirements: No local dev/reserved duplicate source evidence; actual ZIP extracted offline output equivalence and interface checks; published size/install/runtime constraints checked. Runtime projection is not a hidden-test guarantee.
scope_of_inference: Three development and three reserved clips are a small pilot; passing supports a measured collision-component improvement on these human references only, not a guaranteed leaderboard gain or complete Stage2 score. Missing direction/entry labels remain missing. No Stage1/3 change. No artificial human annotation.
